name: Lekai Wang
bio: I am a Ph.D. student in mathematics at Nanjing University. My research interests lie in partial differential equations and geometric analysis, particularly biharmonic equations, unique continuation, and nodal sets. I began my doctoral studies in 2024, under the supervision of X. P. Yang. Previously, I completed my undergraduate studies at Jilin University.
research_interests: Elliptic partial differential equations, especially biharmonic equations and higher-order elliptic operators
Quantitative unique continuation and estimates for the order of vanishing
Geometric analysis and the local structure of nodal sets
research_overview: My current interests center on unique continuation and nodal geometry for higher-order elliptic equations, particularly those involving the biharmonic operator Δ². I am interested in how quantitative estimates for the order of vanishing inform the size and local structure of the nodal set.
